events.title: 武汉市新型冠状病毒感染的肺炎疫情防控指挥部交通管制通告

visibility.note: The preserved Xinhua full-text page displays a publication time of 03:15:55; the time is interpreted as China local time (UTC+08) for alignment because the page gives no offset. A later Wuhan municipal government retrospective says the city command issued the notice around 02:00; that approximate issuance time is not the exact page-publication time and neither source proves the first public appearance across all channels. The 10:00 effective time remains a separate sensitivity, not the publication time.

effective_period.note: The reported measures suspended Wuhan public transport and closed outbound airport and railway channels from 10:00; restoration time was to be announced separately.

scope.note: This source is a news report quoting the city command notice. Direct geographic and transport scope is recorded; listed-company exposure is not inferred.

events.title: 关于调整2020年春节休市相关安排的公告

visibility.note: The archived exchange notice gives the date but no verified time of day. Market availability must be aligned against the actual exchange calendar.

effective_period.note: The SSE notice extended the Spring Festival closure through February 2 and stated February 3 would reopen. It also changed some business deadlines; these are not issuer-level return signals.

scope.note: This is an exchange operations and calendar event, not a market-wide economic shock estimate and not evidence for applying an identical return signal to all stocks.
